name: india-stack-mcp
description: Production-grade MCP servers for Indian enterprise systems: Tally, Zoho Books, GST. Agents that can do books and file taxes in India.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @india-stack/core && npm run build -w @india-stack/connector-tally && npm run build -w @india-stack/connector-zoho && npm run build -w @india-stack/connector-gst && npm run build -w @india-stack/demo-host
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/connector-tally --noEmit && tsc -p packages/connector-zoho --noEmit && tsc -p packages/connector-gst --noEmit && tsc -p apps/demo-host --noEmit
